question: Could you help me calculate the average single career span value in years for all baseball players? Please precise the result as a float number. First, calculate the difference in years, months, and days between the debut and final game dates. For each player, the career span is computed as the sum of the absolute number of years, plus the absolute number of months divided by 12, plus the absolute number of days divided by 365. Round each part to two decimal places before summing. Finally, average the career spans and round the result to a float number.

WITH player_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        CAST(debut AS DATE) as debut_date,
        CAST(final_game AS DATE) as final_game_date
    FROM player
    WHERE debut IS NOT NULL 
      AND debut != ''
      AND final_game IS NOT NULL 
      AND final_game != ''
),
career_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        debut_date,
        final_game_date,
        -- Calculate total days between debut and final_game
        CAST(final_game_date AS DATE) - CAST(debut_date AS DATE) as days_diff,
        -- Calculate years as floor of days / 365
        FLOOR(CAST(days_diff AS DOUBLE) / 365.0) as years,
        -- Remaining days after extracting years
        CAST(days_diff AS DOUBLE) - FLOOR(CAST(days_diff AS DOUBLE) / 365.0) * 365.0 as remaining_after_years,
        -- Calculate months from remaining days (using 30.4375 average days per month)
        FLOOR(remaining_after_years / 30.4375) as months,
        -- Days remaining after extracting months
        remaining_after_years - FLOOR(remaining_after_years / 30.4375) * 30.4375 as days
    FROM player_dates
),
career_span_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        days_diff,
        years,
        months,
        days,
        -- career span = years + months/12 + days/365
        -- Round each part to 2 decimal places before summing
        ROUND(years, 2) as years_rounded,
        ROUND(months, 2) as months_rounded,
        ROUND(days, 2) as days_rounded,
        ROUND(years, 2) + ROUND(months, 2) / 12.0 + ROUND(days, 2) / 365.0 as career_span
    FROM career_calc
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(career_span), 2) as avg_career_span,
    COUNT(*) as player_count
FROM career_span_calc
